name: maplevault-local
description: Local desktop application for managing, discovering, and organizing anime series (MapleVault).
author: MapleVault Contributors

scripts.postinstall: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:desktop
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run prepare:package-runtime && npm run verify:package && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:package-runtime && npm run verify:package && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare:package-runtime && npm run verify:package && electron-builder --linux
scripts.audit: npm audit && npm --prefix app/backend audit && npm --prefix app/frontend audit
scripts.audit:fix: npm audit fix && npm --prefix app/backend audit fix && npm --prefix app/frontend audit fix
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run test:backend
